simple.meaning: קָרוֹב (qârôwb) is a Hebrew action word meaning “near (in place, kindred or time).” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 78 times in Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 19 more, beginning at Genesis 19:20. The surrounding contexts include family, flock, city, land, Egypt, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קָרוֹב (H7138) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: קָרוֹב (qârôwb) / H7138 is traced through Genesis 19:20, Genesis 45:10, Exodus 12:4, Exodus 13:17 with source-language evidence and verse context.
